OFFICE MEMORANDUM

Subject: Implementation of mandatory Aadhar-based
identification / authentication of beneficiaries under Section
142 of the Code on Social Security, 2020 -reg.

The undersigned is directed to refer to Government of India,
Ministry of Labour & Employment letter No. S-38013/04/2021-SS-| dated
17th May, 2026, copy enclosed, which is self-explanatory and relates to
compliance with the mandate of the Code. In this regard, all the Regional
Directors/ Joint Directors I/c/ Deputy Directors I/c and all other field units
are advised to comply with the mandate of Code and give wider
circulation among the beneficiaries and employers ffor its
implementation with immediate effect.

This has been issued with the approval of Director General.

Digitally signed by
Chandra Bhanu Jha
